payload.posture: Read Acts 11:27–30 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states relief is sent through Barnabas and Saul. Now in these days, prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch. which they also did, sending it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
